build_auto_nmap_module_wrapper: build an AutoNmapModuleWrapper that automatically applies nmap to callables in a wrapped module
create_wrap_module_function: create a wrap_module function that wraps a module to automatically apply named_axes.nmap to callables
run_auto_nmap_on_jax_module: run auto_nmap.wrap_module on jax to get njax with nmap-ped callables for named-axis operations
run_auto_nmap_on_jax_numpy: run auto_nmap.wrap_module on jax.numpy to get njnp with nmap-ped linalg and array functions
test_auto_nmap_module_wrapper: test the AutoNmapModuleWrapper class that wraps modules and lifts positional JAX functions into named-axis variants
